title: A library's declarations of roles — visual-communication capability
description: Formal shape of a library's `roles.yaml` (DEC-004 points 2, 7, 8 and 10): the roles it declares, each with its type and a default that aliases an older role; and, in the foundations, the shared axes with their kind, modes and default, the colour families and their members, the shapes a notation maps a concept to (DEC-036 point 1), and the pairs of colour roles that must contrast at WCAG's levels. A role carries no value: a brand gives it one. Document-shaped schema. Companion per COR-018.

pkit_schema.description: The schema that binds this file (COR-023; DEC-002 point 3): `visual-communication:roles`.

schema_version.description: The format number, shared by every schema of the capability (DEC-003 point 1).

roles.description: The roles the library declares, by token path, each with its type and, optionally, a default: an alias to another role, which the role takes wherever no brand gives it a value. In the foundations these are the shared roles, and a default aliases an older role (DEC-004 point 7). In another library of components they are its own roles, each under the group of the library's name and none under `component`; a default aliases another of its own roles or a role of a library it builds on, the shared roles included, of the same type, never a value or a component token (DEC-008 points 1 and 3). A role of the type `picture` takes a picture file of the brand as its value: only the foundations declare one, with no default, and no brand owes it a value (DEC-025 point 4).

shapes.description: The shapes a notation maps a concept to, each an outline by its name, the concept's sign where its notation holds no icon for it (DEC-036 point 1). Only the foundations declare them.
